description: Cancel a pickup order when the user asks, with the claim create_pickup_order returned. An unpaid order just closes. A paid one can be cancelled until the shop starts making it, and what was paid goes back the way it was paid (a card refund can take a few business days to show). Once the shop has started it, or it's ready, the user asks staff at the counter instead.

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: cancel_pickup_order
title: Cancel an order
